M22b.result: MISS: with 27/27 (8.0 avg tool calls, avg 51231ms) vs without 27/27 (10.7 avg tool calls, avg 38929ms) -- with arm used 25% fewer tool calls (8.0 vs 10.7) but that is far short of <= half (would need <= 5.35); correctness tied at 27/27 both arms over 3 fresh hermes-chat/claude-sonnet-5 subagents per arm
M22b.cause: 3 rounds, same failure category each time (R3): claude-sonnet-5 is capable enough to answer every one of the 9 hand-labeled why-questions correctly from the raw backstage ADR corpus alone (16 files, real repo, no hints), so the tree cannot show a correctness gain; it also partially verifies facts against the ADR source even when told the card is a sufficient citation, so the tool-call reduction (25%) falls well short of the >= 2x bar. The miss is honest: a 16-ADR corpus plus a frontier model is not hard enough to separate the arms on this metric, independent of whether the tree is useful in a larger/messier real repo.
